$metadata.description: Extract structured data from scientific journal articles

quality_checks.message: Publication year must be between 1900 and 2100

title: Journal Article Extraction Schema
description: Extract metadata and findings from scientific journal articles. SCOPE: Peer-reviewed research papers. EXCLUDE: Conference papers, preprints, editorials, book chapters.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier. Null if not available.

pmid.description: PubMed ID for medical articles. Null if not applicable.

journal.description: Journal name exactly as written. Null if not stated.

year.description: Publication year (e.g., 2023). Null if not stated.

volume.description: Volume number exactly as written. Null if not stated.

issue.description: Issue number exactly as written. Null if not stated.

pages.description: Page range exactly as written (e.g., '123-145'). Null if not stated.

abstract.description: Article abstract. Null if not provided.

authors.description: Article authors in order of appearance. One entry per author.

affiliation.description: Author's institutional affiliation. Null if not provided.

email.description: Author's email address. Null if not provided.

orcid.description: ORCID identifier. Null if not provided.

findings.description: Key research findings or results. One entry per major finding.

finding.description: Description of the finding or result

methodology.description: Method used to obtain this finding. Null if not specified.

statistical_significance.description: P-value or statistical significance measure. Null if not applicable.

sample_size.description: Sample size for this finding. Null if not stated.

notes.description: Additional context or limitations. Null if none.

research_domain.description: Research field or domain (e.g., 'Neuroscience', 'Climate Science'). Null if not identifiable.
